$comment: Enforces the dspy-jev decision gate as a PreToolUse hook: a held action does
not run, rather than being reported to the model as advice.
The matcher lists the tools that can act on the world. Read, Glob and Grep are
deliberately absent -- the hook would skip them anyway, and not matching them
avoids spawning a process per read.
